rejected_rule.statement: The term 'partition' in section 37 of the Registration Ordinance of 1891 is not restricted to partition by decree of Court, and deeds registered in fresh pages with references back to the original folio satisfy the requirements of the Land Registration Ordinance.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "The term 'partition' in section 37 of the Registration Ordinance of 1891 is not restricted to partition by decree of Court. When the deeds of gift were accordingly registered in fresh pages or folios of the book, the registrar made references to the old folio in which the original registration was contained, and it seems to me that in these circumstances the deeds of gift were duly registered."
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 27 of the Land Registration Ordinance, No. 14 of 1891
